title: Niagara River Guide Service
specs: Fishing for Salmon, Steelhead, Lake Trout, Brown Trout, Smallmouth Bass, Walleye, Muskies

blurb: Guests fish for Salmon, Steelhead, Walleye, Musky, Smallmouth Bass, Trout, Perch, and other sportfish. The service operates out of historic Lewiston, New York, near Niagara Falls. Trips include scenic views of forts, Devils Hole, and hydroelectric plants.
extraNote: Historic Lewiston, New York, 4 miles north of Niagara Falls
